SELECT 
  fished_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  AVG(yt) as avg_yt,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  AVG(anglers) as avg_anglers
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  MAX(fished_date_doy) as latest_fished_doy,
  MAX(avail_doy) as latest_avail_doy,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  AVG(yt) as avg_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 2

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as yt,
  AVG(yt) as avg_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 AND fished_date_doy >= 25
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy DESC, cls
